title: Residuals that reveal the wrong model
caption: A straight line fitted to a cooling curve leaves residuals that are positive at both ends and negative in the middle (+ − − − − + +). A systematic pattern like this says the model is wrong: the data follow T = T_room + ΔT e^(−kt).
alt: Temperature against time for a cooling object with a straight best-fit line, and a residual plot below showing a U shape.
description: Temperatures 80, 56.4, 42.1, 33.4, 28.1, 24.9, 23 °C at 10-minute intervals from 0 to 60 minutes.
Straight-line fit: gradient -0.89 °C per minute, intercept 67.7 °C.
Residuals in order: + − − − − + +. Random scatter would mix signs; a U shape means curvature the line cannot follow.
